headline.head: THE MAYE-NIX HOLY WAR ENDS WITH BOTH CANDIDATES GONE
headline.sub: Drake Maye left in the first quarter in Munich and gave maruniak 3.02. BDALOHA, owner of the league's only Bo Nix, was chopped at 106.52. Bo Nix then went through the 3am wire without a single claim, not even a $0 one. By 6:47am maruniak had added C.J. Stroud. Nobody won the debate. Everybody just left.

offWire.headline: Report: Pats QB Maye could miss rest of season with fractured ankle
offWire.text: Aidan Hutchinson sacked Drake Maye on the opening drive in Munich, Maye did not return, and the Lions won 35-10. ESPN's Schefter and Rapoport report a fractured ankle that could end his season. The ankle is nobody's fault. The reaction is maruniak's: cut Ashton Jeanty, who scored 10.4 on the bench Sunday, and grab C.J. Stroud at 6:47am. At 3am maruniak had also paid $56 for Kenneth Walker III, who missed Week 10 with a groin injury. The Maye Defenders' campaign chair switched parties and bought an injured running back in the same morning.

kickoff.nudge: Colts at Texans (IND @ HOU) opens Week 11 Thursday at 8:15 ET. maruniak, your brand-new C.J. Stroud plays first, so decide if he is your QB before Thursday, not after. PumpUpTheJam32 has Jonathan Taylor, kaelanzm has Nico Collins and Tyler Warren. Lock it in early.
kickoff.miss: Week 10's worst lineup call: Stefon Diggs scored 20.3 for Sdobens4 on Thursday night, from the bench. Sdobens4 then had three full days to fix it and started Jalen Coker on Sunday instead. Coker scored 0.3.

roast.benched: maruniak benched Parker Washington and watched him catch 7 balls for 152 yards and a touchdown, 28.2 points, while Tee Higgins put up 11.6 in the flex. That is 16.6 points left in the drawer. maruniak survived anyway, then spent Wednesday morning shopping for a quarterback instead of a better lineup.
roast.flop: BDALOHA paid $101 for Brock Bowers, $37 clear of PumpUpTheJam32's unpaid $64, and got two catches, 18 yards and an ankle injury on the opening drive. The ankle was bad luck. The $101 was a choice. At 3am Wednesday, kaelanzm bought the same Bowers for $33.
roast.fresh: The commissioner's 3am: JSN claimed Zach Charbonnet at 3:05, cut him at 3:34 for Harold Fannin Jr., cut Fannin two minutes later for Davante Adams, who is on IR, then re-added Fannin 19 seconds after that. Charbonnet lasted 29 minutes on the roster. Fannin got dropped and re-signed faster than a text gets unsent. This is the man who runs the league.
roast.top: JSN put up 182.86, led by George Pickens catching 11 for 145 and three touchdowns. Meanwhile RotoBaller's top waiver target this week is Jordyn Tyson. He is already on the commissioner's bench, where he scored 19 and did not count.
roast.bottom: BDALOHA scored 106.52, last by 18.10. Harold Fannin Jr. put up 16.1 on the bench while Rachaad White started in the flex for 6.2. Swap them and it is 116.42, still chopped. Some weeks the lineup is wrong. This week the roster was.
roast.spread: 76.34 points from first to last. George Pickens and Emmett Johnson combined for 78.6 on JSN's roster alone, so two of the commissioner's players outscored the entire gap between the top of the league and the guy who just got chopped.
roast.escape: Sdobens4 survived by 18.10 while starting a 0.3 over a 20.3 sitting on the bench. That is the second straight week Sdobens4 left 20-plus points on the pine: Jordan Love's 36.18 in Week 9, Stefon Diggs's 20.3 in Week 10. Survival by spite remains undefeated.
roast.chopped: BDALOHA goes out with $67 of $1,000 left. Tony Pollard, the $299 Week 3 buy that BDALOHA famously benched, led the team with 23.9 in its final game. Wednesday at 3am kylereckert bought him for $86. BDALOHA overpaid for Pollard, benched Pollard, and went out the one week Pollard was the best player on the roster.
roast.bigWallet: kaelanzm has spent $959 of $1,000, the most of anyone still alive, and has Puka Nacua and Jeremiyah Love both on IR. Wednesday kaelanzm spent another $33 on a tight end coming off an ankle injury. Second place, a hospital wing on the bench, and $41 to last the rest of the season.
roast.tightWallet: PumpUpTheJam32 is the richest survivor at $191. Lost the bids on Pollard, Walker, Flowers and Bowers this week, all unpaid, then took Drake London for $10, a week after losing him with a $41 bid. Meanwhile jayabg, elifelber, KRogo5 and Sergio are still holding a combined $4,000 in a league they are no longer in.

value.stealJab: $11 for Ollie Gordon II and 15.5 points, and the commissioner also picked Emmett Johnson off free agency on Nov. 13 for nothing and got 35.1 (101 rushing yards, two receiving touchdowns). JSN won the week by 25.8 with players the rest of you could have had for nothing.
value.lowballJab: JSN offered $0 for Brock Purdy. PumpUpTheJam32 paid $15, got 389 yards and three touchdowns, 31.66 points, and left all of it on the bench behind Josh Allen. Purdy has now scored 57.94 on two different benches in two weeks.

paper.obituary: BDALOHA, Week 10. Spent $933, including $299 on a Tony Pollard who led the team in its last game. Started a $101 Brock Bowers who hurt his ankle on the opening drive. Took Bo Nix to the grave, and the wire buried him with zero bids. Survived by $67 and a resale market.

jabs.flop: One hundred and one dollars for 18 yards and a trainer's visit.
jabs.lowball: A zero-dollar quarterback bid that aged better than the winning one.
jabs.steal: Eleven dollars, and the commissioner still found a cheaper guy on the street.
